description: This file defines common React functional components used for UI elements such as modals, badges, and empty states, likely used across the frontend application.

methods.name: Modal({ open, onClose, title, children, actions })
methods.description: A React component that renders a modal dialog with overlay, title, content, and optional actions. It handles open/close via props and handles click events for closing.

methods.name: Pill({ color = 'var(--color-primary)', children })
methods.description: A React component that renders a badge element with specified color and children content.

methods.name: EmptyState({ title, subtitle, action })
methods.description: A React component that presents a centered empty state UI with title, subtitle, and optional action element.

ctags.name: Modal
ctags.pattern: /^export function Modal({ open, onClose, title, children, actions }) {$/
